svg.title: Cloud Auction Platform – System Architecture
svg.desc: API Gateway and four Spring Boot microservices on Azure Container Apps with PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and the equivalent local Docker Compose setup.
svg.text: System architecture · Spring Boot microservices on Azure Container Apps, with an equivalent local Docker Compose setup
Microsoft Azure · resource group rg-ruhuna-auction · Central US
only the gateway is public · services use internal ingress
API Gateway · Spring Cloud Gateway MVC · port 8080
Also serves the web UI (static HTML + JS) · exposes /actuator/health and /actuator/prometheus
Azure Database for PostgreSQL · Flexible Server 16 · one database per service
and issues the app's own JWT
